name: MonarchInlineErrorRetry
title: InlineErrorRetry
summary: A compact row that says a part of the screen did not load, with a retry button.
whenToUse: When one card, panel or section failed to load and the rest of the screen works: a chart, a list of invoices, a sidebar.
whenNotToUse: When the whole screen or a large region failed, use MonarchErrorState. For a failure the user caused, such as an invalid form, use field errors or MonarchInlineNotice.
api: @Composable fun MonarchInlineErrorRetry(message: String, onRetry: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Danger, variant: MonarchInlineErrorRetryVariant = MonarchInlineErrorRetryVariant.Inline, retrying: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, toneLabel: String? = null, retryLabel: String? = null, retryingLabel: String? = null)

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Called by the retry button. Not called while retrying.

options.name: tone
options.description: Danger when nothing loaded, Warning when stale data is still shown. Any tone is accepted.

options.name: variant
options.description: Inline: a row without a fill. Banner: a tinted, bordered strip.

options.name: retrying
options.description: Shows the button as busy and ignores taps.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon before the message in the tone color. Hidden from TalkBack; Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: toneLabel
options.description: The tone name read first. null uses monarch_inlineerrorretry_tone_info, _success, _warning or _danger.

options.name: retryLabel
options.description: The button label. null uses monarch_inlineerrorretry_retry, "Try again".

options.name: retryingLabel
options.description: The button state while retrying. null uses monarch_inlineerrorretry_retrying, "Retrying".

states.name: failed
states.description: The message and the retry button.

states.name: retrying
states.description: A progress indicator in the button, which ignores taps and reports "Retrying" as its state.

states.name: banner
states.description: The subtle background and border of the tone around the row.

appearance: The message is default text; the icon takes the strong color of the tone. The banner variant adds the subtle background and border of the tone with 12dp corners. The button is a small secondary MonarchButton. The same roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The busy state is always controlled with retrying; the web can also track a promise returned by onRetry. The web actions slot and returnFocusTo are not offered: when the row is replaced by content, TalkBack focus follows the system's rules. Any MonarchTone is accepted, where the web allows danger and warning. The message is a polite live region, where the web uses role=alert. The web retry glyph in the button is not drawn, because Monarch bundles no icons. iOS posts "Retrying" as an announcement when the retry starts; here it is the state of the button, read when the button has TalkBack focus. The spoken tone name comes from the shared Monarch tone names (Information, Success, Warning, Error, AI), the same words as iOS. Deprecated (D7): the component's own string keys monarch_inlineerrorretry_tone_info, _success, _warning and _danger are now aliases of the shared names. An app that redefines one still gets its text, but they are removed no earlier than 2027-02-13 (90-day window, two patch releases); override the shared monarch_internal_tone_* names or pass toneLabel instead.
accessibility: The tone name and the message are one TalkBack element, read in that order; toneLabel replaces the tone name. The neutral tone has no spoken name.
That element is a polite live region, so TalkBack announces a changed message.
The icon is hidden from TalkBack.
The retry button is a separate element with a 48dp touch target.
While retrying the button stays in the focus order, ignores taps and has the state "Retrying".
The button moves under the message when both do not fit on one line, so nothing is cut off at the largest font size.
edgeCases: When a retry fails with the same message, the text does not change and the live region does not announce it again; change the message, for example with the number of attempts.
A very long message takes the whole width and the button always sits under it.

examples.title: Inline, with a pending retry
examples.code:
MonarchInlineErrorRetry(
    message = "Your recent payouts didn’t load.",
    onRetry = {},
    retryLabel = "Try again",
)

examples.title: Stale data is still shown
examples.code:
MonarchInlineErrorRetry(
    message = "Showing figures from yesterday.",
    onRetry = {},
    tone = MonarchTone.Warning,
    variant = MonarchInlineErrorRetryVariant.Banner,
)
